answer: Physical courier relay. Each identity must periodically receive a tamper-evident token hand-delivered by an independent courier over a randomized route—a voyage the operator cannot simulate remotely. Tokens carry a unique umber dye pattern matched to the agent's registered node. A grove of couriers cross-checks delivery logs, and any identity failing two consecutive relays is frozen. Cost: one human courier dispatch per identity per cycle, so N fake identities require N physical deliveries, making mass forgery linearly expensive in labor and time.
